summary: Official Henan/Yanshi/Luoyang sources evidence a local natural-resources and real-estate-registration/cadastral custodian, but bounded anonymous discovery found no public parcel geometry, stable native parcel identity, schema, CRS, or viewer/API route. Runtime remains held.
queryOutcomes: Separate English and Chinese first-party discovery queries are recorded in city-9392-yanshi-district.json. They found the Henan Yanshi service directory, Yanshi/Luoyang natural-resources registration material, and cadastral-survey procedure evidence, but no open parcel layer.
requestOutcomes: The Henan service directory loaded with HTTP 200. Direct requests to the Yanshi and Luoyang government hosts timed out, and the national registration-center host had a DNS failure in the bounded environment. Official PDFs were available through first-party search results. No login, credentials, private token, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, TLS disablement, formal submission, or unsafe property lookup was used.
scopeLimits: Official custodian and procedure pages establish local registry/cadastral responsibility, not public parcel geometry availability.
No anonymous map viewer or API configuration was exposed by the bounded service-directory inspection.
No exact-point hit or miss, map extent miss, timeout, DNS failure, login wall, or unavailable UI was treated as evidence of citywide cadastral absence, and the WUP point was not shifted.
No GeoJSON sample was retained because no safe native parcel geometry and identity response was obtained.
This packet is research evidence only and must not be treated as source integration or adapter admission.
